title: Fractal-ish Complexity for Regulations: A Practitioner-Ready, Agentic Benchmark

contributions.purpose: 为法规文本提供可解释的结构复杂度信号
contributions.mechanism: RFI 指数:加权融合规模(标题密度)+层级熵 H+交叉引用查找压力,0-4 分,自动适配全文/短摘录两种模式
contributions.evaluation: FAR 子部示例:Subpart 1.1 RFI≈2.18、5.2≈2.04、31.2≈2.28(均判 Complex);无独立验证集,仅示例+消融
contributions.domain: 法律信息学/法规复杂度度量
contributions.source_quote: We present the Regulatory Fractal-ish Index (RFI), a transparent, scope-aware signal of textual complexity for regulations and SOP-style documents.

contributions.mechanism: 同时报告 headings/1k words(HD)与 cross-refs/1k words(CRw)长度归一化密度及逐节指标
contributions.evaluation: 作为护栏指标随 RFI 一并输出(如 Subpart 1.1 HD≈24/1k、CRw≈10/1k);定性防作弊,无量化验证
contributions.source_quote: We report headings/1k words (HD) and cross-refs/1k words (CRw) alongside per-section metrics to deter cherry-picking.

contributions.purpose: 在不过度声称的前提下呼应分形直觉
contributions.mechanism: 跨句/段/节三分辨率对 log N vs log(1/scale) 做 log-log 拟合估斜率 D_hier 与 R^2
contributions.evaluation: FAR 示例 D_hier≈1.0,R^2≈1.0;明确声明不驱动最终判级、不主张正式分形维数
contributions.source_quote: Dˆhier is a log–log slope across text resolutions (sentences→paragraphs→sections), with R2 for goodness of fit.

contributions.purpose: 让监管从业者可实际使用与复现
contributions.mechanism: 确定性 agentic 流水线三步(解析→计算 RFI→出报告),输出 JSON+一页政策简报含可执行编辑建议
contributions.evaluation: CPU 笔记本可跑,~5000 词 <1 分钟、内存 <200MB;种子固定可复现
contributions.source_quote: Deterministic scripts produce JSON plus a plain-English policy brief suitable for practitioners.

notes: reject。协议适配问题:这是提出度量+工具的 benchmark 类论文,但缺真正的经验验证——evaluation 只给 FAR 少数示例的 RFI 数值和定性消融,声称的 micro-validation(Spearman ρ+95% bootstrap CI)在 checklist 里写成'will report'(未做);消融也是定性('blurs the separation''hides lookup hops')无数字。作者态度诚实(scope 明确自限:'We do not claim a formal fractal dimension of regulations or a general theory of legal complexity',generalization 列为 future work)。AI 自我披露(AI Involvement Checklist):实验设计/数据分析/写作/可视化均为 C 级(AI 主导),写作项自承'The AI generated most of the manuscript text and structure';人类仅做约束、政策贴合度与合规审校。权重 w1-w4 为人工设定(0.25/0.35/0.25/0.15)未经调参验证。无 self-declared provenance(有引用 Katz&Bommarito 等但非 extend/adapt/replace 表述)。
